_readme: Composition path ledger — the memory of the choose-your-own-adventure. One entry per finished song: the committed path ids, the measured verdicts, and which branches were proven or broken by that walk. `select_path` reads this to exclude recently used options (variety) and to prefer `measured` evidence over `untested`. Append-only; never rewrite history — a branch that failed in one song may pass in another context.

psydub_cave.walked: free-form (before the tree existed) — reconstructed retroactively as the first ledger entry
taught: the corpus kick fill gives only 1.5 hits/bar — explicit Euclidean counts are required (rhythm node recipe)
a kick in EVERY section collapses the arc to 1.1 dB; removing it from intro/outro/breakdown restored 14.1 dB (arrangement node)
element-level transient shaping does not move the crest (+0.23 dB, peak x0.989)
RAVE print -> transform -> re-import works: export_audio a stem (seconds), rave_transform_file (5 s), re-import as a sampler layer

buses/sends have no agent surface — shared returns are impossible, so the space node is per-track FX + lanes [UPDATED 2026-09-23: now false — buses/sends have a full agent surface (add_bus / add_send / remove_bus / remove_send / list_buses) and send levels are automatable (paramID 2000 + sendIndex); shared returns are buildable and measured (aether_dub: +2.85 dB on the send). Original ledger entry kept as history.]

phrygian_embers.walked: ledger-driven: psydub_cave's path excluded, which forced 3 untested branches

branch_results.deep-phrygian: PROVEN — 128 BPM / E Phrygian held; arc 16.0 dB
branch_results.sample-led: PROVEN WITH CAVEAT — the found palette worked (Kampfer kick, 'Jah Rastafari' dub recording in E, E-minor arps from WS Dark + Inside Mind, Kenzee clap), but sampler-led phrase cells come out far too thin (stab 3 notes / 32 bars, lead+bass 8): set explicit density for sampler palettes
branch_results.broken-midtempo: PROVEN — corpus perc gave uneven 56/112-note patterns over a straight kick; the metre stayed legible
branch_results.growl-wobble: PROVEN — but with no sub layer the kick reads weaker (kickProminence 0.730 vs 0.854 on psydub_cave). The bass node sets the low-end character, not just its level
branch_results.gated-dub: PROVEN — 512-point steppedGate lanes on perc+stab, and they ALSO satisfied the modulation coverage for those two tracks (gesture lanes count as movement)
branch_results.slow-burn: PROVEN AT THE ARC, LOP-SIDED — arc 16.0 dB but drop2 0.161 vs drop1 0.060 rms (8.6 dB step), and that step was the peak driver (true peak 2.01 -> master 0.447). Cap the last drop's kick level rather than lowering the whole master
branch_results.none (texture): FINE — no texture layer needed; nothing was missing
branch_results.measure-dont-guess: WORKED, WITH ONE ORDER VIOLATION — the measure pass set master 0.6036, then the late-added movement pass raised the level and the final render clipped at 1.000. Movement MUST precede mix

cost.note: measure + v1(clipped, order violation) + canary + final; a clean walk on this path should be 3 (canary after all mutations, then final)

taught: the tree had no `movement` node — the walk failed the coverage gate and the node was added; node ORDER puts movement before mix for a reason (see mutation-order trap)
sampler-led palettes need explicit cell density

dub_embers.walked: hand-designed from a detailed musical brief (7-layer varied percussion, jazzy 7th/9th pad with per-note modulation, modal corpus riffs, 3/16 Rhodes skank + tape echo, dub drop-out) - the branches are now recorded in the dub tree

verdict.gates: all six PASS (v2 and v3 both; v1 clipped)

tonality.chords: Cm9 (C Eb G Bb D) <-> Fm9, 4-bar blocks; the 9th sits a semitone above the minor 3rd (the mellow-dissonant cluster)
tonality.verified: tone_verity f0 read G, Bb, D on the three pad voices (fifth, 7th, 9th) and C on the skank; bass F in an iv block - every fundamental is a chord tone, nothing sour
tonality.gate_that_saved_it: analyze_midi_file rejected 49 of 104 MIDI files labelled '[C] [Natural Minor]' (8 wrong root, 2 actually MAJOR); the filename labels were not trusted

branch_results.seven-layer-seeded: PROVEN WITH CAVEAT - 7 layers work, but seeded randomness returned LOOPS (a 105 BPM hat loop, a 162 BPM shaker break, a kick+snare+tom loop) until filtered to one-shots (duration <= 3s, no loop/break/bpm markers)
branch_results.steppers-one-drop-hybrid: PROVEN - kick on 4 quarters + rim on beat 3 + clap on 2-and-4. A pure one-drop FAILED the psytrance-shaped backbeat gate; the clap hybrid passes it and reads as electro-reggae
branch_results.cm9-three-voices: PROVEN - 3 voices with independent LFOs (0.07/0.11/0.17 Hz) into the synth cutoff; tone_verity confirms the chord tones
branch_results.three-sixteenth-rhodes-tape-echo: PROVEN - DX7 RHODES EGH (Keys.syx v3) chopping every 3/16 through saturator -> delay(dotted-1/8) -> LPF 3.2k -> small reverb, with a 0.6 Hz wow LFO on the delay time and an adsr feedback arc 0.35->0.80. CAVEAT: HDAW has no in-loop filter, so repeats darken once, not per generation
branch_results.analysed-corpus-riff: PROVEN - the analysis gate is the whole story here (see tonality.gate_that_saved_it)
branch_results.one-drop-holes-and-drum-dropout: PROVEN - intro without kick + a kickless, drumless breakdown gave an 8.4 dB arc
branch_results.window-probe: PROVEN AND CHEAP - verify_part on an 8-beat window in the loudest drop returned mixPeak in ~2 s, replacing a 7-minute canary render (true peak 2.25 -> master 0.395)

cost.note: 3 were wasted: the first full export produced no file despite reporting success, then the rebalance pushed the peak over twice. The window probe is the fix for the last two.

taught: render time scales with automation density: 300 s of this 15-track/~8.5k-note/~15k-automation-point arrangement took 410-430 s, slower than realtime
MIDI pack labels lie - always gate on analyze_midi_file
`audit_song_structure`'s backbeat gate is psytrance-shaped; a roots one-drop fails it by design
bass:high measured 30:1 even after rebalancing - the genre is bass-dominant but the mid/high detail needs deliberate lifting
a default compressor on a bass track can make the bassline inaudible - audition the bass solo INSIDE a drop window, never from beat 0 (a dub bass has no clip in the intro)
root-third-fifth per bar is not a bassline; a 4-bar riff with a hook bar is
claps deserve delay+feedback and their own placements, not just a backbeat role
pad modulation reads as static below ~30 s cycle lengths however deep it is

revision_2_user_feedback.feedback: claps exist/use them + delay with feedback; the 3/16 chop is inaudible; some elements unclear; background chord needs more / longer + subtle modulation; no distinct bassline
revision_2_user_feedback.diagnosis: the bassline measured 0.0143 solo rms / 0.0316 peak (vs kick 0.123) because a DEFAULT compressor (threshold -20 dB, 4:1) was clamping a hot synth; the skank was NOT quiet (solo peak 0.34) but masked and smeared by delay mix 0.34 + LPF 3.2k

fixes.bass: compressor threshold -20 -> -6 dB, ratio 4:1 -> 2:1, fader 1.0, EQ +3.5 dB @120 Hz (kick -3 dB @130 Hz to make room), and a REWRITTEN RIFF (4-bar shape with a hook bar: octave jump + syncopation) -> 0.0561 / 0.1133
fixes.chop: delay Mix 0.34 -> 0.18, LPF 3.2k -> 8k, +3 dB presence @3 kHz, kick -2.5 dB @2.5 kHz to unmask -> solo peak 0.340 -> 0.4472
fixes.claps: own delay (dotted-1/8, fb 0.58, mix 0.40) + pickup hits every 2 bars + offbeat doubles every 8 bars
fixes.pads: LFO depth 0.45 -> 0.22 (subtler) PLUS a second LFO per voice at 0.017-0.031 Hz (30-60 s cycles) on a different target, and envelope cycles 8 -> 3 (~100 s sweeps)

revision_2_user_feedback.remaining: bass:high is still ~29:1 on the mix bands — the low end (kick + sub) dominates; the mid/high detail is present and unmasked per-element but the overall tonal balance is still bass-heavy

aether_dub.walked: ledger-driven; 7 of 9 branches had never been walked. Built with every earlier lesson applied up front (no post-hoc fixes except the drum chains, see below).

branch_results.hardware-virus: PARTIAL - the REAL Virus (OsTIrus CLAP-OsTIrus-7fd3f0df-0, 6939 params) carried the BASS, shaped by its own params (Ch 1 Filter 1 Cutoff = paramID 139, Resonance 146, Sub Oscillator Volume 134) and driven by a filter-arc lane on its HARDWARE cutoff. Pads/skank stayed internal: each plugin instance costs an isolated child, and this path already tested 7 fresh branches
branch_results.half-time-dub: PROVEN - kick on 1 + snare on 3 (plus syncopated fills) gave a 10.9 dB arc
branch_results.sub-only: PROVEN but thin - one low voice with no mid-bass leaves kickProm at 0.386; the low end reads as sub rather than a defined bassline unless the mid-bass slot is used
branch_results.filter-arc: PROVEN - macro/openClose/phaseSweep arcs on the pads (2800 points each) and on the Virus's own filter
branch_results.rave-only: PROVEN - export a stem (verify the folder exists first!), rave_transform_file with vintage.ts, re-import as a sampler layer (11 s for 27 s of audio)
branch_results.gesture-lanes-only: PROVEN - 13/13 coverage from lanes ALONE with no per-track LFOs; drums via the built-in Volume lane, everything else via filter/eq arcs
branch_results.window-probe: FAILED ON THIS PROJECT - verify_part exceeded a 120 s call budget twice (every render spawns/warms the plugin child); fell back to render-and-rescale. The probe recipe is for sampler-only projects

cost.note: one was lost to the export-directory bug; two to the un-tamed drum crest

taught: drum one-shots need their transient chain from the start: without it the crest measured 30.7 dB (true peak 3.12); adding kick/perc saturators brought it to 2.01
export_audio writes NOTHING (and still reports success) when the output directory does not exist
the window probe recipe does not survive plugin instances in the project
a mid-bass slot is what makes a low end read as a bassline rather than a sub (kickProm 0.386 vs 0.47-0.51 with one)
one-lane-per-paramID bit again: a named lane on paramID 1 silently collides with the built-in Volume lane

aether_dub_returns.walked: POST-HOC capability exercise, NOT a fresh walk: the return pair was added to an already-finished aether_dub, so arrangement/rhythm/palette were inherited rather than chosen. Purpose was to exercise the new machinery end to end - bus/send creation, bus FX params, the shared delay DSP, the filter bus, set_bus_target, and the re-runnable automation pass.

path.rides: arc-pass mechanism only (paramID-addressed + clear:true + replace:true run twice -> identical point count); return-ride and staging-pass NOT walked
path.inherited: the rest from aether_dub (foundation hypno-half-time, arrangement two-drop-classic, movement gesture-lanes-only, mix window-probe)

verdict.hpf_evidence: chained delay return bass 18627 -> 15505 (-17%) / sub 5645 -> 4445 (-21%); re-parented reverb return sub 4604 -> 3698 (-20%)

branch_results.shared-return: PROVEN - +2.85 dB on the send itself; whole track rms 0.0720 -> 0.0814 with all six gates green
branch_results.filter-bus-hpf: PROVEN - a filter bus (Mode 1, 250 Hz) behind a return removes its lows; measured both chained and re-parented
branch_results.set_bus_target: PROVEN - the default Reverb return re-parented behind an HPF; self/master/unknown/cycle all refused with specific errors

cost.note: one 300 s render plus five 16 s A/B windows

taught: A bus return's Mix defaults to 0.5, which re-adds a doubled dry signal - set Mix 1.0 for a pure return (trap: bus-return-mix).

Send levels are NOT automatable (no paramID range), so a per-phrase throw must come from a per-track delay slot (trap: send-levels-not-automatable). [UPDATED 2026-09-23: send levels ARE automatable - paramID 2000 + sendIndex; measured in walk_minimal_3track below.]
A bus created after the graph was last prepared is never prepared itself, and processing it corrupted memory until FxBusProcessor::processBlock grew a fail-safe guard.
A rebuild that connects while creating silently fell back to master for a parent later in BUS_LIST - fixed by the two-phase rebuild in set_bus_target.

walk_minimal_3track.walked: Deliberate minimal 3-track walk (sub_synth / fm_synth / psy_fm internal instruments, 24 notes, tempo 120, 16 beats) driven over MCP stdio to prove the two unproven branches. Offline renders only (disconnected RDP session - no live audio route); audibility proven before any gate (peaks to +/-0.755).

path.rides: arc-pass + return-ride + staging-pass (all three, as a node, for the first time)

verdict.gates: movement-plan PASS; return-ride PASS; arc-pass PASS; staging-pass PROVEN WITH CAVEAT (interaction, below)

branch_results.movement-plan: PROVEN - apply_movement_plan {trackId, preset: subtleLife/openClose/pump, start 0, end 16} wrote 16/64/64 Volume points in ONE undo unit (okCount 3, failCount 0); gate audit_modulation_coverage -> attentionRequiredIds == [], fullyCovered 3/3. CAVEAT: preset events default to paramID 1 (Volume), which makes every touched track faderOverridden - see staging-pass.
branch_results.return-ride: PROVEN - delay bus (busID 2) + send (sendIndex 0) + return Mix 1.0 / Feedback 0.65; A/B export send 0.0 vs 1.0 -> mix_diff rmsDb -3.59 (|delta| >= the +1.5 measured bar). The per-phrase RIDE itself: add_automation_lane {paramID 2000} + automation_preset {preset macro, 64 points} -> ride export vs static send-1.0 mix_diff rmsDb -1.47 (audible per-phrase movement).
branch_results.arc-pass: PROVEN (with a pid caveat) - add_automation_lane {paramID 100, laneName Arc, replace true} + automation_preset {preset openClose, clear true, 64 points}; gate tone_verity: baselineAudible true, centroidStart 264.1 -> centroidEnd 284.2, amDepth 2.69. CAVEAT: the filter landed in FX slot 1, so its cutoff pid was 200 - the arc on pid 100 modulated the instrument slot's first param instead, and STILL moved the centroid measurably. Address params by the slot the effect actually landed in.
branch_results.staging-pass: PROVEN WITH CAVEAT - set_track {volume 0.8} applies, but the gate as written (no unintended track in faderOverriddenIds) reports [0,1,2]: movement-plan's default Volume lanes claim fader authority on every track they touch. The two branches interact - run movement-plan with an explicit paramID (not the Volume default) if staging by fader is planned afterwards.

cost.note: five 8 s offline exports + one tone_verity; all offline (no live audio route needed)

taught: apply_movement_plan's preset events default to paramID 1 (the built-in Volume lane): convenient for coverage, but every touched track becomes faderOverridden - plan staging around it.
Send levels ARE automatable now: the return-ride A/B and the 64-point macro lane on paramID 2000 both measured (closes the aether_dub_returns lesson above).
add_fx fxType enum has internal INSTRUMENTS (sub_synth / fm_synth / psy_fm / sampler / psyarp / growl_bass) - a minimal audible walk needs no CLAP plugins and no audio route, only offline exports.
Internal-synth instrument slots occupy FX slot 0: the first insert FX lands in slot 1, so its compound pid starts at 200, not 100.

branch_stats._note: derived view for select_path: how often a branch has been walked and whether it held its gate
